(async()=>{ [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.title==='Edit: cut sections out and join clips').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); return document.querySelector('.modal h3').textContent; })()

(async()=>{ [...document.querySelectorAll('.modal button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Highlight reel')).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const q=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); q.querySelector('select').value='30'; q.querySelector('select').dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); q.querySelector('.btn.primary').click(); for(let i=0;i<40;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const st=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal .muted')].map(x=>x.textContent).find(t=>t.startsWith('Kept')||t.startsWith('Could not')); if(st) return st; } return 'timeout'; })()

(async()=>{ const m=document.querySelector('.modal'); const tot=()=>[...m.querySelectorAll('.inline > b')].pop().textContent; const before=tot(); [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Speed')).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Freeze frame')).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return 'total ' + before + ' -> ' + tot() + ' | rows: ' + [...m.querySelectorAll('.cut-row')].map(r=>r.innerText.split('\n').join(' ')).slice(-2).join(' || ') + ' | bar: ' + m.querySelectorAll('.edit-bar .spd').length + ' speed, ' + m.querySelectorAll('.edit-bar .frz').length + ' freeze'; })()

(async()=>{ const m=document.querySelector('.modal'); [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Next: export')).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); const d=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); const row=[...d.querySelectorAll('.row-field')].find(r=>r.textContent.startsWith('Title')); row.querySelector('.toggle .on').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return d.querySelector('.modal-body p').textContent + ' | text opts visible: ' + (d.querySelector('.text-opts').style.display!=='none') + ' | title: ' + row.querySelector('input').value; })()

(async()=>{ const d=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Preview').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return 'subtitle panel visible: ' + __app.view.subMesh.visible; })()

(async()=>{ document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.title==='Edit: cut sections out and join clips').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const m=document.querySelector('.modal'); [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Remove a section')).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim().endsWith('Preview')).click(); const v=__app.player.video; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const t1=v.currentTime; v.currentTime=71.8; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); return 'preview started at ' + t1.toFixed(1) + ' s; crossing the cut 72-108 s jumped to ' + v.currentTime.toFixed(1) + ' s'; })()
